Accountant (Audit, Tax) Job at Global Linkers Limited




        
    

        
        Global Linkers Limited - Our client, a reputable Audit, Tax, Finance and Accounting Consulting Firm, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant (Audit, Tax)

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking to hire a highly competent and detail-oriented Accountant to join its professional team.
	The ideal candidate must have practical experience in audit and taxation, with prior experience in an audit, tax, finance, or accounting consulting firm being highly preferred.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records, accounts and financial statements.
	Support audit assignments, including planning, fieldwork, documentation and reporting.
	Prepare and review tax computations, returns and related statutory documentation.
	Assist clients with accounting, financial reporting and tax advisory requirements.
	Perform account reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
	Support the preparation of management accounts, budgets and financial analysis.
	Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations and statutory requirements.
	Liaise with clients and relevant stakeholders to obtain financial information and resolve accounting or tax-related issues.
	Assist in identifying financial, accounting and tax risks and recommend appropriate solutions.
	Maintain proper working papers and documentation for audit and consulting engagements.
	Stay updated on changes in accounting standards, tax laws and regulatory requirements.
	Perform other accounting, audit and consulting duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.
	Professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent is an added advantage.
	Proven audit and tax experience is mandatory.
	Previous experience working in an audit, tax, finance or accounting consulting firm is highly preferred.
	Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
	Good understanding of Nigerian tax and statutory compliance requirements.
	Excellent analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to work with confidential financial information.
	Excellent communication and client-management skills.
	Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a consulting environment.


Remuneration
N550,000 – N800,000 monthly, depending on experience, qualification and demonstrated competence.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their cv to [email protected] using "Application – Accountant (Audit)" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only candidates who meet the stated requirements will be considered.

	Supervising and supporting administrative staff, including hiring, scheduling, training and performance evaluations
